title: Super tall highway with steep dips going by a huge theme park, circus and its always nighttime.
content: Does anyone dream of driving on steep highways going through tunnels, going high above water or through a snow covered mountain or dense green forest hilltop path? Sometimes I drive off these things or never come out of the other side of the tunnels. I rarely dream of the theme park but only once did I get to walk through rather than a drive over.
